```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Shared publication-style defaults for all figures in this report.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 5,
  dpi = 300,
  out.width = "95%",
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

pipeline_colors_pub <- c(
  "GATK" = "#0072B2",
  "DeepVariant" = "#D55E00",
  "DRAGEN-GATK" = "#009E73"
)

theme_publication <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.15), colour = "grey10"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = rel(0.95), colour = "grey30"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = rel(0.8), colour = "grey35", hjust = 0),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "grey15"),
      axis.text = element_text(colour = "grey20"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "grey15"),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 14, 8, 8)
    )
}

theme_set(theme_publication())
```

# Load Data set

```{r}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(ggVennDiagram)

file_path <- "Variant_analysis.xlsx"

excel_sheets(file_path)

```

## Import all six worksheets

```{r}

resources_raw <- read_excel(
  file_path,
  sheet = "Computational resources",
  skip = 2
)

variant_counts <- read_excel(
  file_path,
  sheet = "Variant Counts",
  skip = 2
)

database_concordance <- read_excel(
  file_path,
  sheet = "Database Con & Variant",
  skip = 2
)

population_dv <- read_excel(
  file_path,
  sheet = "Pop Metrics - DeepVariant",
  skip = 2
)

population_gatk <- read_excel(
  file_path,
  sheet = "Pop Metrics - GATK",
  skip = 2
)

population_dragen <- read_excel(
  file_path,
  sheet = "Pop Metrics - DRAGEN-GATK",
  skip = 2
)

# Confirming the successful imports
excel_sheets(file_path)
dim(resources_raw)


```

# Computational Resources

## Inspecting the Computational resources

```{r}

names(resources_raw)
str(resources_raw)
print(resources_raw, n = Inf, width = Inf)

```

## Cleaning the computational resources tables

```{r}

resource_metrics <- resources_raw %>%
  slice(1:3) %>%
  rename(
    Metric = 1,
    GATK = 2,
    DeepVariant = 3,
    `DRAGEN-GATK` = 4
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = c("CPU utilisation", "CPU time", "Peak memory (RAM)"),
    GATK = c("99.33%", "81.15 h", "4.60 GB"),
    DeepVariant = c("99.94%", "12.42 h", "108.85 GB"),
    `DRAGEN-GATK` = c("97.90%", "117.04 h", "10.39 GB")
  )

# Adding the wall-clock time row, which was imported as column names
resource_metrics <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    Metric = "Wall clock time",
    GATK = "81.63 h",
    DeepVariant = "10.55 h",
    `DRAGEN-GATK` = "119.57 h"
  ),
  resource_metrics
)

# Call-set information table
callset_info <- resources_raw %>%
  slice(6:8) %>%
  transmute(
    `Call set` = `Wall clock time`,
    `Final jVCF` = `81,63 h`,
    Samples = as.integer(`10,55 h`)
  )

# Converting computational metrics into a tidy format for plotting.
resource_metrics_long <- resource_metrics %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(GATK, DeepVariant, `DRAGEN-GATK`),
    names_to = "Pipeline",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Numeric_value = as.numeric(
      gsub("[^0-9.]", "", Value)
    ),
    Unit = case_when(
      Metric == "Wall clock time" ~ "hours",
      Metric == "CPU time" ~ "hours",
      Metric == "CPU utilisation" ~ "percent",
      Metric == "Peak memory (RAM)" ~ "GB"
    )
  )

# Inspect the clean dataset
print(resource_metrics_long, n = Inf)
str(resource_metrics_long)

```

## Plotting graphs

```{r}

# Graph 1: Comparing wall-clock time across pipelines
ggplot(
  filter(resource_metrics_long, Metric == "Wall clock time"),
  aes(x = Pipeline, y = Numeric_value, fill = Pipeline)
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(Numeric_value, " h")),
    vjust = -0.4
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Wall-clock Time by Variant-calling Pipeline",
    x = "Variant-calling pipeline",
    y = "Wall-clock time (hours)"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = pipeline_colors_pub
  ) +
  theme_publication() +
  expand_limits(y = 135)


# Graph 2: Compare CPU utilisation across pipelines
ggplot(
  filter(resource_metrics_long, Metric == "CPU utilisation"),
  aes(x = Pipeline, y = Numeric_value, fill = Pipeline)
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(Numeric_value, "%")),
    vjust = -0.4
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CPU Utilisation by Variant-calling Pipeline",
    x = "Variant-calling pipeline",
    y = "CPU utilisation (%)"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = pipeline_colors_pub
  ) +
  theme_publication() +
  expand_limits(y = 110)


# Graph 3: Compare peak memory usage across pipelines
ggplot(
  filter(resource_metrics_long, Metric == "Peak memory (RAM)"),
  aes(x = Pipeline, y = Numeric_value, fill = Pipeline)
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(Numeric_value, " GB")),
    vjust = -0.4
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Peak Memory Usage by Variant-calling Pipeline",
    x = "Variant-calling pipeline",
    y = "Peak memory (GB)"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pipeline_colors_pub
  ) +
  theme_publication() +
  expand_limits(y = 125)

```

## Interpreting the results carefully

The wall-clock time (10.55 hours) for DeepVariant seems to be quite
smaller than its CPU time (12.42 hours). However, this might happen when
the CPU time is calculated for all workers. However, we need to confirm
the measurement methods of run time and CPU time from the logs provided
by you. The memory values for all the pipelines need to be verified on
similar lines.

# VARIANT COUNTS & CALLSET QUALITY

## Inspecting the Variant Counts dataset

```{r}

names(variant_counts)
str(variant_counts)

print(variant_counts, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Check for missing values
colSums(is.na(variant_counts))

```

## Cleaning the Variant Counts dataset

```{r}

variant_counts_clean <- variant_counts %>%
  mutate(
    GATK = as.numeric(GATK),
    DeepVariant = as.numeric(DeepVariant),
    `DRAGEN-GATK` = as.numeric(`DRAGEN-GATK`)
  )

# Inspect the cleaned dataset
print(variant_counts_clean, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Check column types
str(variant_counts_clean)

# Check for missing values
colSums(is.na(variant_counts_clean))


# Create a presentation-ready Variant Counts table

variant_counts_display <- variant_counts_clean

count_metrics <- c(
  "Total variants",
  "SNPs",
  "INDELS",
  "Multiallelic variant",
  "Biallelic variant",
  "HWE-deviant sites (P<10^-6)"
)

for (pipeline in c("GATK", "DeepVariant", "DRAGEN-GATK")) {

  values <- variant_counts_clean[[pipeline]]
  display_values <- as.character(values)

  # Format count metrics as whole numbers
  idx_count <- variant_counts_clean$Metric %in% count_metrics

  display_values[idx_count] <- format(
    round(values[idx_count]),
    scientific = FALSE,
    big.mark = "",
    trim = TRUE
  )

  # Format SNP/INDEL and overall Ti/Tv ratios
  idx_ratio <- variant_counts_clean$Metric %in% c(
    "SNP/INDEL ratio",
    "Ti/Tv ratio — overall"
  )

  display_values[idx_ratio] <- formatC(
    values[idx_ratio],
    format = "f",
    digits = 2
  )

  # Format known and novel Ti/Tv ratios
  idx_titv <- variant_counts_clean$Metric %in% c(
    "Ti/Tv — known variants",
    "Ti/Tv — novel variants"
  )

  display_values[idx_titv] <- formatC(
    values[idx_titv],
    format = "f",
    digits = 6
  )

  # Format heterozygous/homozygous ratio
  idx_het <- variant_counts_clean$Metric == "Het/hom ratio"

  display_values[idx_het] <- formatC(
    values[idx_het],
    format = "f",
    digits = 4
  )

  # Format percentages
  idx_percent <- variant_counts_clean$Metric %in% c(
    "Hardy-Weinberg deviation  (%)",
    "Multiallelic %"
  )

  display_values[idx_percent] <- paste0(
    formatC(
      values[idx_percent] * 100,
      format = "f",
      digits = 2
    ),
    "%"
  )

  variant_counts_display[[pipeline]] <- display_values
}

# Print the formatted table
print(variant_counts_display, n = Inf, width = Inf)

```

## Prepare the plotting data

```{r}

variant_counts_long <- variant_counts_clean %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(GATK, DeepVariant, `DRAGEN-GATK`),
    names_to = "Pipeline",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

# Set a consistent pipeline order
variant_counts_long <- variant_counts_long %>%
  mutate(
    Pipeline = factor(
      Pipeline,
      levels = c("GATK", "DeepVariant", "DRAGEN-GATK")
    )
  )

```

```{r}
  labs(

    x = "Pipeline",
    y = "Number of variants",
    fill = "Pipeline"
  ) +
  theme_publication()

```

```{r}

#Graph 5: Hardy-Weinberg and multiallelic metrics

hwe_metrics <- c(
  "Hardy-Weinberg deviation",
  "HWE-deviant sites (P<10^-6)",
  "Multiallelic %"
)

hwe_data <- variant_counts_long %>%
  filter(Metric %in% hwe_metrics) %>%
  mutate(
    Value = if_else(
      Metric %in% c("Hardy-Weinberg deviation", "Multiallelic %") &
        Value <= 1,
      Value * 100,
      Value
    ),
    Metric = factor(Metric, levels = hwe_metrics),
    Pipeline = factor(
      Pipeline,
      levels = c("GATK", "DeepVariant", "DRAGEN-GATK")
    )
  )

ggplot(
  hwe_data,
  aes(
    x = Pipeline,
    y = Value,
    color = Pipeline,
    group = 1
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = 1),
    color = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = if_else(
        Metric == "HWE-deviant sites (P<10^-6)",
        scales::comma(Value, accuracy = 1),
        paste0(sprintf("%.2f", Value), "%")
      )
    ),
    vjust = -0.8,
    size = 3.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Metric,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "GATK" = "#C8A2C8",
      "DeepVariant" = "#4169E1",
      "DRAGEN-GATK" = "#A3B18A"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Hardy-Weinberg and Multiallelic Metrics by Pipeline",
    x = "Variant-calling pipeline",
    y = "Value",
    color = "Pipeline"
  ) +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

# DATABASE CONCORDANCE AND VARIANT NOVELTY

## Inspect the Database Concordance and Variant Novelty worksheet

```{r}
# Inspect the Database Concordance and Variant Novelty worksheet

# View all rows and columns
print(database_concordance, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Check dimensions
dim(database_concordance)

# Check column names
names(database_concordance)

# Check data types
str(database_concordance)

# Check missing values per column
colSums(is.na(database_concordance))

```

## Clean the main metrics worksheet

```{r}

percentage_metrics <- c(
  "dbSNP concordance rate",
  "gnomAD — common variants — MAF ≥ 0.05 in gnomAD",
  "gnomAD — rare variants — MAF < 0.05 in gnomAD",
  "Novel variant rate — Absent from gnomAD entirely",
  "dbSNP-known rate",
  "Novel rate"
)

count_metrics <- c(
  "3-caller overlap",
  "Caller-unique variants",
  "Known SNPs",
  "Novel SNPs",
  "dbSNP-known variants",
  "Novel / absent from dbSNP"
)

# Function to format one cell based on its metric
format_metric_value <- function(value, metric) {

  if (metric %in% percentage_metrics) {
    return(paste0(
      formatC(
        as.numeric(value) * 100,
        format = "f",
        digits = 2
      ),
      "%"
    ))
  }

  if (metric %in% count_metrics) {
    return(format(
      as.numeric(value),
      big.mark = ",",
      scientific = FALSE,
      trim = TRUE
    ))
  }

  # Preserve descriptive text as it is
  return(as.character(value))
}

# Apply the formatting function to each pipeline column
database_concordance_display <- database_concordance %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    GATK = format_metric_value(GATK, Metric),
    DeepVariant = format_metric_value(DeepVariant, Metric),
    `DRAGEN-GATK` = format_metric_value(`DRAGEN-GATK`, Metric)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Display the formatted table
print(database_concordance_display, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Verify dimensions
dim(database_concordance_display)


# Prepare numeric data for analysis and plotting

database_concordance_long <- database_concordance %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(GATK, DeepVariant, `DRAGEN-GATK`),
    names_to = "Pipeline",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Numeric_value = if_else(
      Metric %in% c(
        "Pairwise concordance",
        "Primary-chromosome SNPs"
      ),
      NA_real_,
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(gsub(",", "", Value, fixed = TRUE))
      )
    )
  )

# Inspect the analysis-ready data
print(database_concordance_long, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Check which metrics could not be converted
database_concordance_long %>%
  filter(
    !Metric %in% c(
      "Pairwise concordance",
      "Primary-chromosome SNPs"
    ),
    is.na(Numeric_value)
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)


```

```{r}
  mutate(
    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = rev(database_count_metrics)
    ),
    Pipeline = factor(
      Pipeline,
      levels = c("GATK", "DeepVariant", "DRAGEN-GATK")
    )
  )

ggplot(
  database_count_plot,
  aes(
    x = Numeric_value,
    y = Metric,
    color = Pipeline
  )
) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = 0,
      xend = Numeric_value,
      y = Metric,
      yend = Metric
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.65),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.65),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = database_concordance_colors
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_comma()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Variant Counts: Database Concordance and Novelty",
    x = "Number of variants",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Variant-calling pipeline"
  ) +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

# POPULATION METRICS — DeepVariant + GLnexus

## Cleaning the population metrics worksheet

```{r}

population_dv_clean <- population_dv %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Metric),
    trimws(as.character(Metric)) != ""
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = trimws(as.character(Metric)),
    across(-Metric, ~ trimws(as.character(.x)))
  )

# Converting values to numeric for analysis
population_dv_numeric <- population_dv_clean %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(`African (n=3)`, `European (n=2)`, `SAC (n=39)`),
      ~ {
        value <- trimws(as.character(.x))
        is_percentage <- grepl("%", value, fixed = TRUE)

        value <- gsub("%", "", value, fixed = TRUE)
        value <- gsub(" ", "", value, fixed = TRUE)
        value <- gsub(",", ".", value, fixed = TRUE)

        numeric_value <- as.numeric(value)

        ifelse(
          is_percentage,
          numeric_value / 100,
          numeric_value
        )
      }
    )
  )

dim(population_dv_numeric)

str(population_dv_numeric)

colSums(is.na(population_dv_numeric))

# Checking for conversion errors
population_dv_numeric %>%
  filter(
    is.na(`African (n=3)`) |
    is.na(`European (n=2)`) |
    is.na(`SAC (n=39)`)
  ) %>%
  
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)


# Display the cleaned Population Metrics table

knitr::kable(
  population_dv_clean,
  caption = "Population Metrics — DeepVariant + GLnexus",
  format = "html",
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r")
)
  
```

```{r}
# GRAPH 4: Population Variant Characteristics Heatmap — DeepVariant + GLnexus
# Emphasise differences between populations for each metric

heatmap_metrics_dv <- population_dv_numeric %>%
  filter(
    Metric %in% c(
      "SNP/INDEL ratio",
      "Multiallelic %",
      "Ti/Tv",
      "Missingness",
      "HET/HOM_ALT ratio"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`African (n=3)`, `European (n=2)`, `SAC (n=39)`),
    names_to = "Population",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Population = factor(
      Population,
      levels = c("African (n=3)", "European (n=2)", "SAC (n=39)")
    ),
    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = c(
        "SNP/INDEL ratio",
        "Multiallelic %",
        "Ti/Tv",
        "Missingness",
        "HET/HOM_ALT ratio"
      )
    ),
    Display_value = case_when(
      Metric %in% c("Multiallelic %", "Missingness") ~
        sprintf("%.2f%%", Value * 100),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", Value)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  mutate(
    Relative_value = if (
      max(Value, na.rm = TRUE) == min(Value, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) {
      rep(0.5, n())
    } else {
      (Value - min(Value, na.rm = TRUE)) /
        (max(Value, na.rm = TRUE) - min(Value, na.rm = TRUE))
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Draw heatmap
ggplot(
  heatmap_metrics_dv,
  aes(x = Population, y = Metric, fill = Relative_value)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Display_value),
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "azure2",
    high = "aquamarine4",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
    labels = c("Lowest", "Intermediate", "Highest"),
    name = "Within-metric\nrelative value"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Population Differences in Variant Characteristics",
    subtitle = "DeepVariant + GLnexus",
    x = "Population",
    y = "Variant metric",
    caption = paste(
      "Colours compare populations within each metric.",
      "Labels show the original values."
    )
  ) +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}

population_dragen_numeric <- population_dragen_clean %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      -Metric,
      ~ {
        value <- trimws(as.character(.x))
        is_percentage <- grepl("%", value, fixed = TRUE)

        value <- gsub("%", "", value, fixed = TRUE)
        value <- gsub(" ", "", value, fixed = TRUE)
        value <- gsub(",", ".", value, fixed = TRUE)

        numeric_value <- as.numeric(value)

        ifelse(
          is_percentage,
          numeric_value / 100,
          numeric_value
        )
      }
    )
  )

# Check dataset dimensions
dim(population_dragen_numeric)

# Check column types
str(population_dragen_numeric)

# Check for missing values
colSums(is.na(population_dragen_numeric))

# Identify any conversion errors
conversion_errors_dragen <- population_dragen_clean %>%
  filter(
    if_any(
      -Metric,
      ~ {
        value <- trimws(as.character(.x))
        value <- gsub("%", "", value, fixed = TRUE)
        value <- gsub(" ", "", value, fixed = TRUE)
        value <- gsub(",", ".", value, fixed = TRUE)

        !is.na(value) &
          value != "" &
          is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value)))
      }
    )
  )

# Display conversion errors, if any
print(conversion_errors_dragen, n = Inf)

# TABLE: Population Metrics — DRAGEN-GATK

  population_dragen_clean,
  caption = "Population Metrics — DRAGEN-GATK",
  format = "html",
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r")
)
```

# Comparison of the Germline Variant Calling Pipelines

```{r}

# Inspect the relevant worksheet
print(database_concordance, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Inspect the metric names
unique(database_concordance$Metric)

# Reset invalid printing options
options(na.print = "NA")

# Check the option
getOption("na.print")

```

The overlap categories below are the reported summary counts. The same
seven mutually exclusive regions are used for the bar chart, UpSet-style
plot, caller set sizes, pairwise intersections, and Jaccard similarities
so these outputs cannot silently disagree with one another. Confirm
these source counts against the original variant-level callsets before
interpreting them as validated results; the earlier draft contained a
second, conflicting set of counts.

```{r}

# THREE-WAY VARIANT-CALLSET OVERLAP

overlap_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Category, ~GATK, ~DeepVariant, ~`DRAGEN-GATK`, ~Alleles,
  "Shared by all three",                  1, 1, 1, 24671447,
  "GATK and DeepVariant only",             1, 1, 0,   140463,
  "GATK and DRAGEN-GATK only",             1, 0, 1,  1597711,
  "DeepVariant and DRAGEN-GATK only",      0, 1, 1,   124008,
  "GATK only",                             1, 0, 0,   379282,
  "DeepVariant only",                      0, 1, 0,  1556938,
  "DRAGEN-GATK only",                      0, 0, 1,   326422
)

stopifnot(
  all(overlap_data$Alleles >= 0),
  !anyDuplicated(overlap_data$Category),
  sum(overlap_data$Alleles) > 0
)

overlap_data$Category <- factor(
  overlap_data$Category,
  levels = overlap_data$Category[order(overlap_data$Alleles)]
)

knitr::kable(
  overlap_data %>% select(Category, Alleles),
  col.names = c("Exclusive intersection", "Allele records"),
  caption = "Reported mutually exclusive three-caller overlap counts",
  format.args = list(big.mark = ",")
)
```

```{r overlap-bar-plot, fig.width=8.5, fig.height=5.5}
ggplot(overlap_data, aes(x = Alleles, y = Category)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0072B2", width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = comma(Alleles)),
    hjust = -0.12,
    size = 3.2,
    colour = "grey15"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_comma(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.22))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Variant Allele Overlap Across Three Pipelines",
    subtitle = "Exclusive regions of the reported caller intersection",
    x = "Number of allele records",
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "Counts are summary inputs and have not been independently validated",
      "against variant-level records."
    )
  ) +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

A true Venn diagram requires the actual allele identifiers in each
caller set. The previous draft generated tens of millions of artificial
identifiers from summary counts; that is computationally expensive and
does not validate the underlying overlap. The Venn plot is therefore
omitted rather than presenting synthetic identifiers as observed variant
data. The UpSet-style plot below uses the reported mutually exclusive
counts directly.

## UpSet-style plot and pairwise similarity

```{r upset-and-jaccard, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
pipeline_names <- c("GATK", "DeepVariant", "DRAGEN-GATK")

regions <- overlap_data %>%
  mutate(
    id = factor(
      Category,
      levels = as.character(Category[order(Alleles)])
    ),
    degree = GATK + DeepVariant + `DRAGEN-GATK`
  )

# Caller set sizes are derived from the exclusive regions.
set_sizes <- tibble::tibble(
  set = pipeline_names,
  n = vapply(
    pipeline_names,
    function(s) sum(regions$Alleles[regions[[s]] == 1]),
    numeric(1)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(set = factor(set, levels = pipeline_names))

matrix_df <- regions %>%
  select(id, GATK, DeepVariant, `DRAGEN-GATK`) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(pipeline_names),
    names_to = "set",
    values_to = "member"
  ) %>%
  mutate(set = factor(set, levels = pipeline_names))

short_label <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x >= 1e6, paste0(round(x / 1e6, 1), "M"),
         ifelse(x >= 1e3, paste0(round(x / 1e3, 1), "K"), as.character(x)))
}

p_top <- ggplot(regions, aes(x = id, y = Alleles)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey35", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = short_label(Alleles)), vjust = -0.45, size = 2.8) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = short_label, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.18))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Intersection size\\n(log scale)") +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

p_sets <- ggplot(set_sizes, aes(x = n, y = set, fill = set)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = comma(n)), hjust = -0.12, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pipeline_colors_pub, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_comma(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.22))
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(pipeline_names)) +
  labs(x = "Alleles per caller", y = NULL) +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

p_matrix <- ggplot(matrix_df, aes(x = id, y = set)) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey85", size = 3.2) +
  geom_line(
    data = matrix_df %>%
      filter(member == 1) %>%
      group_by(id) %>%
      filter(n() > 1),
    aes(group = id),
    colour = "grey35",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(matrix_df, member == 1),
    aes(colour = set),
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pipeline_colors_pub, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(pipeline_names)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

p_all <- ((p_top / p_matrix) | p_sets) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(3, 1.2), heights = c(2.1, 1)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "Concordance Between Variant Callers",
    subtitle = "Each column represents one mutually exclusive caller intersection",
    caption = paste(
      "Intersection counts are displayed on a log scale in the upper panel.",
      "All set sizes and pairwise statistics are derived from the same summary table."
    ),
    theme = theme_publication()
  )

print(p_all)

# Pairwise intersections include the all-three region.
pairwise_summary <- function(a, b) {
  shared <- sum(regions$Alleles[regions[[a]] == 1 & regions[[b]] == 1])
  union <- sum(regions$Alleles[regions[[a]] == 1 | regions[[b]] == 1])
  tibble::tibble(
    Caller_1 = a,
    Caller_2 = b,
    Intersection = shared,
    Union = union,
    Jaccard = shared / union
  )
}

jaccard_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  pairwise_summary("GATK", "DeepVariant"),
  pairwise_summary("GATK", "DRAGEN-GATK"),
  pairwise_summary("DeepVariant", "DRAGEN-GATK")
) %>%
  mutate(Jaccard = round(Jaccard, 4))

knitr::kable(
  jaccard_table,
  col.names = c("Caller 1", "Caller 2", "Intersection", "Union", "Jaccard similarity"),
  caption = "Pairwise caller concordance derived from the reported exclusive regions",
  format.args = list(big.mark = ",")
)

ggsave("upset_caller_concordance.png", p_all, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
ggsave("upset_caller_concordance.pdf", p_all, width = 11, height = 7, device = "pdf")
```

**Interpretation note:** Jaccard similarity is the size of the pairwise
intersection divided by the size of the pairwise union. It measures
set-level overlap, not whether the callers are equally accurate;
accuracy requires an appropriate truth set or independent validation.

# Four-panel bar chart for SAC individuals (n = 39)

```{r}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

data_dir <- "."

excel_file <- "Variant_analysis.xlsx"

callers <- c("GATK", "DeepVariant", "DRAGEN-GATK")

files <- c(
  "GATK" = "persample_gatk.tsv",
  "DeepVariant" = "persample_dv.tsv",
  "DRAGEN-GATK" = "persample_dragen.tsv"
)

cols <- pipeline_colors_pub

required_files <- file.path(data_dir, c(unname(files), "groups.txt"))
missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing input files: ",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = ", "),
    "\nCurrent working directory: ", getwd()
  )
}


counts <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(files), function(nm) {
  readr::read_tsv(
    file.path(data_dir, files[[nm]]),
    col_names = c("caller_code", "sample", "class", "sites", "copies"),
    col_types = "cccdd"
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Pipeline = nm)
}))

groups <- readr::read_tsv(
  file.path(data_dir, "groups.txt"),
  col_names = c("sample", "Group"),
  col_types = "cc"
)

class_levels <- c("common", "lowfreq", "rare", "novel")

class_labels <- c(
  "Common (AF_grpmax ≥ 0.05)",
  "Low-frequency (0.01 ≤ AF_grpmax < 0.05)",
  "Rare (0 < AF_grpmax < 0.01)",
  "Novel (absent from gnomAD)"
)

sac <- counts %>%
  filter(class %in% class_levels) %>%
  inner_join(filter(groups, Group == "SAC"), by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(Pipeline = factor(Pipeline, levels = callers),
         class = factor(class, levels = class_levels, labels = class_labels))
stopifnot(n_distinct(sac$sample) == 39)

summ <- sac %>%
  group_by(class, Pipeline) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(sites), sd = sd(sites), .groups = "drop")

base_theme <- theme_publication() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")


p_bar <- ggplot(summ, aes(x = Pipeline, y = mean, fill = Pipeline)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(y = mean + sd, label = comma(round(mean))), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ class, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = "SAC individuals (n = 39)",
       x = NULL, y = "Variant sites per individual (mean \u00B1 SD)", fill = NULL) +
  base_theme
print(p_bar)

gatk_mean <- summ %>% filter(Pipeline == "GATK") %>% select(class, gatk = mean)
pct <- summ %>% left_join(gatk_mean, by = "class") %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * (mean - gatk) / gatk) %>%
  filter(Pipeline != "GATK")
p_pct <- ggplot(pct, aes(x = Pipeline, y = pct, fill = Pipeline)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_col(width = 0.55) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%+.1f%%", pct), vjust = ifelse(pct >= 0, -0.5, 1.4)), size = 3.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ class, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = "Difference from GATK in SAC individuals (n = 39)",
       x = NULL, y = "Difference in variant sites per individual (% of GATK mean)", fill = NULL) +
  base_theme
print(p_pct)

ggsave(file.path(data_dir, "SAC_four_panel_bars.png"), p_bar, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(data_dir, "SAC_four_panel_bars.pdf"), p_bar, width = 9, height = 7)
ggsave(file.path(data_dir, "SAC_difference_from_GATK.png"), p_pct, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 600, bg = "white")

```
